content:
Hi all — we’re organizing the Lean Refactor Competition, a competition associated with a NeurIPS 2026 AI for Verifiable Coding workshop, with cash prizes for winning solutions.

The goal is to explore automated refactoring of Lean proofs, including making proofs shorter, faster to compile, and more maintainable across Lean/Mathlib versions.

The warm-up stage is now live, and we’d love to get feedback and participation from the Lean community. We can use this thread for questions, discussion about the benchmarks/evaluation, and anything related to the competition.

Competition page: leanrefactor.github.io
Workshop page: https://vericodegen.github.io/
